model.name: claude-opus-5[1m]
model.note: The agent definition template names claude-fable-5, but this evaluation was actually produced by claude-opus-5[1m] (Opus 5, 1M context). Both model.name and model.evaluator_model record the true runtime identity rather than the template default. Temperature 0.0 is the nominal agent setting; the runtime sampling parameters were not independently observable from inside the agent.

issues_detected.description: regulatory_restrictions.regulatory_restrictions asserts that 'No export controls or other regulatory restrictions apply to the dataset or to individual instances', while the same block records hipaa_compliant: compliant, confidentiality_level: restricted, and an other_compliance entry describing a Certificate of Confidentiality that must be asserted against subpoenas and court orders. The blanket negative contradicts the restrictions documented beside it unless read narrowly as covering export controls only.
issues_detected.recommendation: Narrow the free-text statement to export controls specifically, or restate it as 'no export controls apply; other regulatory obligations are recorded in other_compliance'.

issues_detected.description: All fifteen contributors are typed with the slot principal_investigator, including several the record's own notes describe as non-PI contributors ('Co-lead of tools, software and IT infrastructure', 'Ethics module', 'Lead for genomic data collection'). The role assignment is broader than the evidence in the notes supports.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reserve principal_investigator for the co-PIs (Bensoussan, Elemento) and express the remaining contributions through credit_roles (software, supervision, investigation) or a non-PI creator slot.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present is false, while participant_privacy.reidentification_risk states that voice can never be fully de-identified and that k-anonymization with k greater than or equal to two is not achieved. A release that does not reach k=2 retains quasi-identifying combinations, so the boolean is stronger than the accompanying risk narrative. The record partially resolves this by withholding all raw waveforms, and it discloses the tension rather than hiding it.
issues_detected.recommendation: Scope the boolean explicitly to the released feature files, or record identifiable_elements_present as true with the mitigation (raw audio withheld, controlled access) carried in deidentification_details.

issues_detected.description: parent_datasets is absent although the record documents a complete version lineage (v1.0 on Health Data Nexus through v3.1.0 on PhysioNet). The lineage is expressed only through related_datasets typed relationships and was_derived_from prose, so a consumer reading the parent_datasets slot alone sees no ancestry.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate parent_datasets with the version predecessors already named in related_datasets (doi:10.13026/k81f-qr68, doi:10.57764/qb6h-em84).

issues_detected.description: The funding award number OT2OD032720, the NIH project numbers 3OT2OD032720-01S1 and -01S3, the RePORTER application id, the award amount and the project dates are all carried inside the free-text funders[0].notes rather than in structured grant fields. The information is complete and correctly formatted but is not machine-readable as grant metadata.
issues_detected.recommendation: Move the award identifier and project period into dedicated grant slots so the funding link is queryable.

issues_detected.description: collection_timeframes gives only a relative duration ('collected over a period of twelve months') with no start or end date, even though the record carries precise absolute dates for every release (Nov 2024 through 1 May 2026). The collection window therefore cannot be placed on a timeline.
issues_detected.recommendation: Anchor the twelve-month window with approximate start and end dates, or state that the sources give only a duration.

issues_detected.description: known_biases uses a controlled bias_type vocabulary (selection_bias, representation_bias, measurement_bias, annotation_bias) but carries no AI Ontology (AIO) term identifiers, and the fairness discussion is entirely qualitative. No demographic counts or per-group distributions are given anywhere in the record, so the documented skew cannot be quantified by a reader.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add AIO CURIEs to each bias_type and record the demographic and cohort distributions that the subpopulations entries describe only as 'skewed'.

semantic_insights: DOI prefix 10.13026 is PhysioNet's registered prefix and is used correctly for the dataset id, the doi slot, the version-independent concept DOI and two related-dataset targets.

Grant number OT2OD032720 follows the NIH pattern correctly (OT2 activity code, OD institute, six-digit serial), and the derived full project numbers 3OT2OD032720-01S1 and -01S3 are well-formed NIH supplement forms.
RRID:SCR_007345 in the citation matches the RRID:SCR_ pattern and is the resource identifier for the hosting repository.
Participant arithmetic is internally consistent: 306 (v1.0) + 136 (v2.0) + 391 (v3.0.0) = 833, matching the count in description and instances[0].counts.

The record distinguishes confidential_elements (legal privilege, doctor-patient confidentiality, absent) from sensitive_elements (race, sexual orientation, health status, present) rather than conflating them, and explains the distinction.

HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification is an appropriate method for linked clinical and demographic data, and the record correctly identifies its insufficiency for voice waveforms, which is why raw audio is routed to controlled access.
Temporal ordering is coherent: collection precedes the release sequence, and issued (2026-05-01) matches the stated v3.1.0 release date and the version in the page URL.

source_caveats states the referent explicitly (the adult feature-only PhysioNet release), records the version-specific versus concept DOI split, and names two upstream disagreements (61,937 recordings versus per-feature record counts; Health Data Nexus versus PhysioNet as distributor) with the resolution rule applied to each.
purposes[0] carries its own source_caveats recording that two equal-ranked sources disagree on the enrollment target (10,000 versus 30,000) and keeps both figures rather than silently choosing one.

Preprocessing is documented at parameter level (25 ms window, 10 ms hop, 400-point FFT, 60 mel bins, sparc at 50 Hz, ppgs at 100 Hz over 40 phonemes) with the generating library pinned to b2aiprep v3.0.0.
Each variable carries a derivation and a measurement_technique, giving per-column provenance rather than a single dataset-level lineage statement.

The record documents negatives honestly where the sources support them: no data cleaning performed, no inter-annotator agreement computable with a single labeler, no impact assessment conducted, no recommended splits, Whisper transcriptions not audited for correctness.

questions.name: Field Completeness
questions.description: Proportion of mandatory schema fields populated
questions.score_label: Approximately 86% of the listed fields populated
questions.evidence: Populated: id (doi:10.13026/8xbn-nq66), title, description (~1,900 chars), keywords (4), license_and_use_terms, doi, page (https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/3.1.0/), creators (15), purposes (4), instances (2), variables (13), regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level (restricted). Absent: resources, parent_datasets.
questions.quality_note: Twelve of the fourteen fields the question names are present and every one carries substantive content rather than a placeholder. The two gaps are real: resources is unused despite a rich external_resources block, and parent_datasets is unused despite a documented five-release lineage, which sits just below the 90% threshold for a 5.

questions.name: Entry Length Adequacy
questions.description: Whether narrative fields have meaningful content length
questions.score_label: Greater than 200 characters
questions.evidence: description runs approximately 1,900 characters and names the cohort structure, the five recruitment sites, the acoustic protocol, the released feature families and the withholding of raw audio. purposes carries four responses, each 250 to 600 characters, covering the 10,000-voice target, model development, acoustic-biomarker standards and voice-data governance norms.
questions.quality_note: Well above the threshold, and length here is carrying information rather than padding: the description states what is in the release and what is deliberately excluded, which is the harder half to write.

questions.name: Keyword Diversity
questions.description: Number of unique keywords describing topic coverage
questions.score_label: Three to seven keywords
questions.evidence: keywords: health, biomarkers, bridge2ai, voice.
questions.quality_note: Four keywords, in the 3-7 band. They are relevant but thin for a multi-cohort clinical acoustic dataset: nothing names the modality families (speech, cough, respiration), the disease cohorts, the derived-feature types, or the machine-learning framing, all of which the description discusses at length. Discoverability is materially below what the record's own content would support.

questions.name: File Enumeration and Type Variety
questions.description: Number of distribution formats and file type diversity
questions.score_label: Two to three file types
questions.evidence: distribution_formats lists three: Apache Parquet (nine named dense feature files including ppgs.parquet, sparc_ema.parquet, torchaudio_spectrogram.parquet), tab-separated values (static_features.tsv, audio_quality_metrics.tsv, the phenotype tables), and JSON (a data dictionary per file, matched by file stem). file_collections and total_file_count are absent.
questions.quality_note: Three formats places this at the top of the 3 band without reaching the 5 band, which needs more than three. The per-format notes are unusually good, naming individual files and their roles, but neither file_collections nor total_file_count is populated, so there is no enumeration of how many files the release actually contains.

questions.name: Data File Size Availability
questions.description: Presence of file size or instance count metadata
questions.score_label: Pass
questions.evidence: instances[0].counts: 833 study participants. instances[1].notes gives per-feature record counts: 29,278 spectrogram, mel spectrogram and MFCC records; 32,522 torchaudio pitch; 28,640 sparc EMA; 31,855 sparc loudness; 31,872 sparc periodicity and pitch; 29,289 phonetic posteriorgram. splits records that no recommended splits are supplied; subpopulations describes two subpopulation axes.
questions.quality_note: Passes on instance counts, which are given at two granularities and explained where they diverge. total_size_bytes is absent, so a user can estimate scale but cannot size a download.

questions.name: Dataset Identification Metadata
questions.description: Presence of unique identifiers such as DOI, RRID, or persistent URLs
questions.score_label: Pass
questions.evidence: id: doi:10.13026/8xbn-nq66; doi: 10.13026/8xbn-nq66; page: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/3.1.0/; publisher: https://physionet.org; version_access.latest_version_doi: doi:10.13026/37yb-1t42; citation carries RRID:SCR_007345.
questions.quality_note: Passes strongly. The record uses the version-specific DOI as the identifier and records the version-independent concept DOI separately, and source_caveats explains that choice, which is the correct handling of a versioned PhysioNet deposit.

questions.name: Funding and Acknowledgements Completeness
questions.description: Presence of funding sources, grants, creator affiliations, and institutional sponsors
questions.score_label: Funders with grants and creators with affiliations, reduced for a role-typing inaccuracy
questions.evidence: funders[0].grantor: National Institutes of Health Common Fund, with notes naming award OT2OD032720, the credited project number 3OT2OD032720-01S1, RePORTER application 11376382 under 3OT2OD032720-01S3, principal investigator Bensoussan, a fiscal year 2025 award of 4,660,942, and a project period of 1 September 2022 to 30 November 2026. All fifteen creators carry an affiliation (University of South Florida, Weill Cornell Medicine, Vanderbilt, MIT, University of Toronto, Hospital for Sick Children, and others).
questions.quality_note: Funding content meets the 5 criterion outright: a named funder, a correctly formatted NIH award, the award period and amount, and complete creator affiliations. Reduced by one for a semantic accuracy problem in the same block: every contributor is typed principal_investigator, including people the record's own notes describe as a software co-lead, ethics-module members and a genomic-collection lead, so the acknowledgement structure overstates the role of eleven of the fifteen. credit_roles is used on only two entries, where it could have carried those distinctions.

questions.name: Ethical and Privacy Declarations
questions.applicability_evidence: Human-subjects condition satisfied from fields outside Q8: description names '833 adult participants recruited at five sites in North America' who 'consented to clinician review of their records'; collection_mechanisms describes a tablet application collecting acoustic tasks and validated questionnaires from participants; data_collectors names research teams and clinicians conducting sessions. Q8's own ethics fields were not used to establish applicability.
questions.description: Comprehensive ethics coverage including IRB approval, deidentification, privacy protections, informed consent, compensation, and vulnerable population safeguards
questions.score_label: Comprehensive human subjects protections and data protection impacts documented
questions.evidence: human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects true with USF IRB approval, single-IRB coverage of US subsites and separate Canadian REB approvals; ethical_reviews names the reviewing organization and records that the study is observational with no data monitoring committee; informed_consent covers consent type (paper, in-app, REDCap, recorded video), documentation, five-year retention, scope including EHR access for diagnosis validation, and a withdrawal mechanism distinguishing withdrawal before and after collection; is_deidentified gives method (HIPAA Safe Harbor plus indirect-identifier removal), an enumerated identifiers_removed list and deidentification_details; participant_privacy gives anonymization_method, privacy_techniques (HIPAA-compliant STRIDES hosting and federated learning), reidentification_risk and data_linkage; participant_compensation records 40 USD under 90 minutes, 80 USD over, capped at 120 USD across three sessions; at_risk_populations records cognitive-impairment and psychiatric cohorts with the discomfort risk noted; regulatory_restrictions.hipaa_compliant compliant and other_compliance naming a Certificate of Confidentiality; data_protection_impacts records that no impact analysis was conducted.
questions.quality_note: The most complete category in the record. Every protection area the question names is populated with specific, checkable content, including compensation amounts and the exact withdrawal boundary. data_protection_impacts is an honest negative rather than an omission, and it names what was done instead (ethicist review of sensitive fields, a published memorandum justifying controlled access). Two semantic issues were weighed and did not reduce the score: identifiable_elements_present false sits uneasily beside the stated failure to reach k=2 anonymization, but the record discloses that tension itself; and the governance committee contact appears in data_governance rather than in regulatory_restrictions.governance_committee_contact, so the contact is present but not at the slot the question names.

questions.name: Access Requirements and Governance Documentation
questions.description: Whether access policy, license, IP restrictions, regulatory restrictions, and confidentiality level are clearly defined
questions.score_label: License plus restrictions plus confidentiality classification
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms names the Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License, states that only credentialed PhysioNet users who sign the agreement may access the files, permits duplication for the research project, forbids sale, requires non-obstructive licensing policies and respect for the Fort Lauderdale Agreement, and sets data_use_permission: general_research_use. ip_restrictions records that no rights transfer, that users may not make IP claims on the data, that downstream IP is permitted under non-obstructive licensing, and that no third party has imposed IP-based restrictions. regulatory_restrictions carries confidentiality_level: restricted, hipaa_compliant: compliant and other_compliance describing the Certificate of Confidentiality and NIH STRIDES agreements. data_governance names the Data Access Compliance Office, the accountable organization (University of South Florida Board of Trustees), a two-tier access_review_process and seven stewardship obligations including five-business-day breach notification.
questions.quality_note: All three components of the 5 band are present and the governance block goes well beyond them, giving the reviewing body, the accountable legal entity, the review path for both access tiers and the recipient obligations. The one blemish is the free-text assertion that no regulatory restrictions apply, which contradicts the Certificate of Confidentiality recorded two lines below it; that is logged as a consistency failure but is a wording defect in one sentence against an otherwise complete block, so it does not move the band.

questions.name: Interoperability, Standardization, and Cross-Platform Integration
questions.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition satisfied: distribution_formats is populated with three formats, page resolves to the PhysioNet landing page for v3.1.0, and license_and_use_terms grants general_research_use to credentialed users.
questions.description: Standard formats, ontologies, schema conformance, typed cross-platform linkages, and dataset integration capability
questions.score_label: Standard formats plus schema and ontology compliance plus integration capability
questions.evidence: distribution_formats: Apache Parquet, tab-separated values, JSON. conforms_to: BIDS v1.9.0 with an explicit scope note that it applies to the audio layout and phenotype folder organization rather than to the Parquet feature files; conforms_to_standard: BIDS; conforms_to_schema: https://w3id.org/bridge2ai/data-sheets-schema; conforms_to_class: Dataset. instances carry ontology CURIEs (B2AI_TOPIC:4, B2AI_TOPIC:36, B2AI_SUBSTRATE:30). related_datasets gives six typed links (is_supplemented_by, is_new_version_of, is_version_of, is_documented_by) each with a resolvable DOI target. external_resources links the b2aiprep and senselab repositories, the REDCap data dictionary and the documentation site. variables document participant_id and session_id as the identifier columns present in every dense feature file and in the phenotype tables, and relationships states how feature records join to participants and sessions.
questions.quality_note: Reaches the top band on all three components. Formats are open and standard, schema and ontology conformance are asserted with a CURIE-bearing vocabulary and a scoped BIDS claim, and integration is genuinely operational rather than aspirational: the join keys are named, their cardinality is stated (a participant may have several sessions), and every file ships a JSON data dictionary keyed to the same stem. The scoping of the BIDS claim is a mark of care, since asserting BIDS over a Parquet feature release would have been the easier and wrong claim.

questions.name: Tool and Software Transparency
questions.applicability_evidence: Software-tools condition satisfied from Q14 fields: external_resources references three code repositories (https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep under Apache-2.0, https://github.com/sensein/senselab, https://github.com/eipm/bridge2ai-redcap under MIT) plus https://github.com/eipm/bridge2ai-docs. Q11's own strategy fields were not used to establish applicability.
questions.description: Preprocessing, cleaning and labeling strategies with the software used, annotation quality, and missing data documentation
questions.score_label: Comprehensive strategies with software versions and URLs
questions.evidence: preprocessing_strategies gives eight entries with numeric parameters: monaural conversion and 16 kHz resampling with a Butterworth anti-aliasing filter; spectrograms of dimension 201 by T from a 25 ms window, 10 ms hop and 400-point FFT, downsampled by two; 60 mel bins and 60 MFCCs at the same settings; sparc articulatory traces at 50 Hz for six articulators; ppgs over 40 phonemes at 100 Hz; static features from openSMILE, Praat, parselmouth and torchaudio; BIDS v1.9.0 restructuring; and generation with b2aiprep, pinned to v3.0.0 for release 3.1.0, with senselab for audio processing. cleaning_strategies records that no cleaning was performed and describes the audit protocol used instead. labeling_strategies records clinician diagnosis with per-cohort gold standards, annotations_per_item 1, and the ICD-10 protocol. annotation_analyses records that no inter-annotator agreement was computable and flags unaudited machine annotations. machine_annotation_tools names OpenAI Whisper Large with tool_accuracy stated as not audited. missing_data_documentation gives patterns, causes and a handling strategy of no imputation with a released missingness table.
questions.quality_note: Top band on every element the question names. The parameters are specific enough to reproduce the feature extraction, the generating library is version-pinned, and the repositories are linked with their licenses. The negatives are as informative as the positives: no cleaning, no agreement statistic possible with a single labeler, and an explicit statement that the Whisper transcriptions were not audited for correctness. imputation_protocols is not populated as a slot, but the substantive answer (no imputation performed) is recorded in missing_data_documentation.handling_strategy.

questions.name: Collection Protocol Clarity
questions.applicability_evidence: Collection-plus-shared condition satisfied: acquisition_methods, collection_mechanisms, data_collectors and collection_timeframes are all populated, and the datasets-shared condition is met via distribution_formats, the PhysioNet page and a research-use license.
questions.description: Completeness of collection mechanisms, acquisition methods, collectors and timeframes
questions.score_label: Full collection protocol with methods, collectors and timeframes
questions.evidence: acquisition_methods gives three typed entries: direct observation and self-report through the tablet application, clinician validation against per-cohort gold standards (laryngoscopy and stroboscopy, brain CT and MRI, spirometry with flow-volume loops), and computational derivation of all released features. collection_mechanisms names the custom application sending over HTTPS to HIPAA-compliant NIH STRIDES cloud storage, the exact hardware (iPad 9th or 10th generation and iPad Air 5th generation with an Avid AE-36 head-mounted microphone through an Apple dongle, distinct devices per site), and REDCap instrument maintenance with export via the consortium library. data_collectors gives three roles: research teams with a trained research assistant present, co-investigator clinicians providing diagnoses and compensated through consortium authorship rather than payment, and hospital staff assisting with logistics. collection_timeframes records twelve months of collection and the per-version participant additions of 306, 136 and 391. sampling_strategies records non-probability sampling with the recruitment setting, screening procedure and an explicit why_not_representative. raw_data_sources gives the source description, type, raw format (WAV, monaural, 16 kHz) and the controlled-access route.
questions.quality_note: All three required components are present at a level of detail that would let a reader replicate the setup, down to the microphone model and the per-site device separation, which is exactly the fact that later becomes the measurement_bias entry. The one weakness is that the timeframe is a bare duration with no anchoring dates, which is noted as a low-severity issue but is not enough to drop the band given the strength of the other components and the dated release sequence recorded elsewhere.

questions.name: Version History, Maintenance, and Sustainability
questions.applicability_evidence: Collection-plus-shared condition satisfied as for Q12.
questions.description: Version information, access methods, errata, update plans, and data sustainability indicators
questions.score_label: Comprehensive versioning plus full sustainability documentation
questions.evidence: version: 3.1.0 with status published and issued 2026-05-01. version_access lists all six releases and gives a per-version changelog: v1.0 with 12,523 recordings from 306 participants, v1.1 adding MFCCs, v2.0 adding 136 participants and reprocessing spectrograms, v2.0.1 correcting authorship, v3.0.0 adding 391 participants and the sparc and ppgs features, v3.1.0 fixing broken Parquet files and adding audio quality metrics; it records that older versions remain supported, that each version has a unique DOI, and gives latest_version_doi. errata gives four entries. updates records semi-annual frequency and the notification channels. maintainers names three: PhysioNet (MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology, supported by NIBIB, NHLBI and the NIH Office of the Director), the consortium with the DACO contact, and T-CAIREM at the University of Toronto for the original Health Data Nexus release. retention_limit distinguishes indefinite retention of the shared dataset from ten-year institutional retention of identifiable data and two-year destruction obligations for raw-audio recipients. extension_mechanism gives a contribution URL.
questions.quality_note: All four sustainability indicators the question names are present: persistent DOIs per version, a governance plan through DACO and the accountable institution, a domain-appropriate biomedical repository in PhysioNet, and institutional commitment through the named NIH institutes supporting the host. The per-version changelog with participant deltas is stronger than a version list, and the retention block is unusually specific about who must destroy what and when.

questions.name: Associated Publications
questions.applicability_evidence: Publication-plus-shared condition satisfied: citation carries a full formal dataset citation with a DOI, and related_datasets carries two is_documented_by entries with publication DOIs; the datasets-shared condition is met as for Q10.
questions.description: Formal citations or external resources with DOI-linked references
questions.score_label: Multiple references and a dataset citation
questions.evidence: citation gives a complete author list, title, version, publisher, RRID:SCR_007345 and https://doi.org/10.13026/8xbn-nq66. related_datasets carries doi:10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926 (Rameau et al. on multi-disorder voice protocols) and doi:10.5281/zenodo.12760724 (the archived REDCap data dictionary) as is_documented_by, plus three dataset DOIs for the pediatric release, v3.0.0 and the Health Data Nexus v1.0. external_resources gives six entries including four repositories, the documentation site and the Synapse controlled-access route. data_governance.notes names a published memorandum on the ethical justification for controlled access. existing_uses names the Bridge2AI Summer School, a hackathon and the Scholars program.
questions.quality_note: Both halves of the 5 band are met: a properly formatted dataset citation and multiple external references, most carrying resolvable DOIs. The Interspeech and Zenodo prefixes are correct for ISCA and Zenodo respectively.

questions.name: Human Subject Representation
questions.applicability_evidence: Human-subjects condition satisfied from the same Q1/Q2/Q12 evidence as Q8: description names 833 adult participants recruited at five clinical sites; collection_mechanisms describes participant-facing collection. Q15's own fields were not used to establish applicability.
questions.description: Inclusion of human subjects, demographic diversity, or subgroup details
questions.score_label: Subgroups and criteria characterized, but no demographic distributions given
questions.evidence: instances[0] records 833 study participants with a per-participant diagnostic label assigned by a site clinician, and notes that a participant may contribute several sessions so phenotype rows are not one per person. subpopulations gives two entries: disease cohorts (voice, neurological and neurodegenerative, mood and psychiatric, respiratory, pediatric, controls) with a distribution note that the releases are not equally distributed and the adult release excludes pediatric participants; and demographic axes (age, gender, sex, ethnicity, socioeconomic status) with a distribution note that the dataset is skewed by site and demographics. at_risk_populations records enrollment restricted to ages 18 to 120 with English-language consent capacity, and names the cognitive-impairment and psychiatric cohorts. sampling_strategies records recruitment against published inclusion and exclusion criteria with chart screening, and a why_not_representative statement. missing_data_documentation explains that disease-specific instruments are absent for participants outside a cohort.
questions.quality_note: Population characterization is strong on structure and on criteria: cohorts are named, the age and language criteria are explicit, and the skew is acknowledged in three separate places. It falls short of the 5 band on demographics, which are named only as axes. No counts, proportions or distributions are given for any group, by cohort, site, sex, race or ethnicity, so a reader cannot assess representation quantitatively even though the record repeatedly says representation is skewed. The inclusion and exclusion criteria are referenced as published rather than enumerated.

questions.name: Findability (Persistent Links)
questions.description: Dataset includes persistent URLs for access and documentation
questions.score_label: Pass
questions.evidence: page: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/3.1.0/; id and doi carry 10.13026/8xbn-nq66; latest_version_doi doi:10.13026/37yb-1t42; external_resources give https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep, https://github.com/sensein/senselab, https://github.com/eipm/bridge2ai-redcap, https://github.com/eipm/bridge2ai-docs, https://docs.b2ai-voice.org/, https://www.synapse.org/Synapse:syn72370534/; existing_uses gives https://www.b2aivoicescholars.org/.
questions.quality_note: Passes with both a persistent identifier and a resolvable landing page, plus eight further external URLs. The version-specific and concept DOIs are both recorded and their roles distinguished.

questions.name: Accessibility (Access Mechanism)
questions.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition satisfied as for Q10: distribution_formats populated, PhysioNet landing page, license granting general_research_use.
questions.description: How users can obtain the dataset
questions.score_label: Fully defined access path covering platform, login and policy
questions.evidence: data_governance.access_review_process gives both tiers end to end: registered access to the feature-only dataset requires PhysioNet registration, identity confirmation and signature of the Bridge2AI-Voice Registered Access Agreement; controlled access to raw audio requires a Data Access Request Form and Data Use Agreement, submission to the Data Access Compliance Office at DACO@b2ai-voice.org, and on approval a Data Transfer and Use Agreement signed by an authorized institutional official, after which data are delivered through Synapse. license_and_use_terms states that no additional training is required and that there are no fees. raw_data_sources.access_details repeats the controlled route with the Synapse URL. third_party_sharing records that recipients may not pass data to collaborators at other organizations, who must apply independently. distribution_formats identifies what is obtained.
questions.quality_note: The full band: platform, credentialing step, signed instrument, reviewing body with a contact address, delivery mechanism and cost are all stated, separately for each of the two access tiers. A prospective user could execute this path without further enquiry. No download_url slot is populated, but the landing page and the Synapse route make that a formatting rather than an information gap.

questions.name: Reusability, Use Guidance, and Social Impact
questions.description: Clear license with explicit intended, prohibited and discouraged uses plus social impact analysis and mitigation
questions.score_label: License plus comprehensive use guidance plus social impact analysis with mitigation
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms as at Q9, with data_use_permission general_research_use. intended_uses gives three research categories with examples and a usage_note that no splits are supplied and users must account for skew. prohibited_uses gives five: re-identification attempts, uses foreseeably causing harm or stigmatization, obstructive IP protection or sale, contacting subjects without IRB approval and provider consent, and onward disclosure beyond named authorized persons. discouraged_uses gives two: non-research applications such as hiring, insurance pricing or surveillance that could lead to discrimination, and uses that assume representativeness. future_use_impacts gives three: non-generalization and unfair treatment of groups from the documented skew, inherited errors from unaudited off-the-shelf transcription models, and anticipated distribution shift from protocol and diagnostic-practice change.
questions.quality_note: All three components of the top band are present. The social impact analysis is specific about who could be harmed and how, and mitigations are attached: users are directed to inspect the multivariate distribution, the consortium commits to remote collection and broader recruitment, and the re-identification risk is mitigated structurally by withholding waveforms. The prohibited and discouraged categories are correctly distinguished, with legally binding terms in the former and advisory guidance in the latter, which is a distinction many records collapse.

questions.name: Data Integrity, Provenance Graph, and Quality
questions.description: Version access, errata, updates, source derivation, parent linkages, missing data, splits and provenance representation
questions.score_label: Full lineage with processing activities, agents and derivation paths
questions.evidence: was_derived_from names the raw audio captured with the Bridge2AI-Voice application together with questionnaire and clinical data exported from REDCap. raw_data_sources gives the source type, raw format and access route. preprocessing_strategies gives the eight-step activity chain from WAV through monaural 16 kHz conversion to each derived feature family, with the generating agents named (torchaudio, sparc, ppgs, openSMILE, Praat, parselmouth) and the orchestrating library pinned (b2aiprep v3.0.0, senselab). Each variable carries its own derivation and measurement_technique, giving a per-column derivation path. version_access, errata (four entries) and updates give the version lineage; related_datasets carries typed is_new_version_of and is_version_of links to the predecessor DOIs. missing_data_documentation gives patterns, causes and handling; splits records that none are recommended; anomalies gives five quality defects including broken Parquet files in v3.0.0; cleaning_strategies describes the pre-release audit protocol and the released audio quality metrics.
questions.quality_note: Above the version-history band. The lineage is expressed in text rather than as a serialized PROV-O graph, which the question permits, and it carries all three graph elements: entities (raw WAV, phenotype exports, each feature family), activities (resampling, STFT, mel and cepstral transformation, articulatory inversion, phoneme posterior estimation, BIDS restructuring) and agents (the named libraries with a pinned version, the clinicians labeling, the consortium curating). Per-variable derivation makes the paths recoverable at column granularity. The one structural gap is that parent_datasets is empty, with ancestry carried in related_datasets instead, which is logged as a low-severity issue rather than a loss of information.

questions.name: Bias Documentation and Responsible AI Alignment
questions.applicability_evidence: Not gated by the sharing condition: a dataset has documentable biases whether or not it is released.
questions.description: Known biases documented with standardized taxonomies and fairness analysis
questions.score_label: Systematic taxonomy-based categorization with qualitative fairness analysis, no ontology mapping or quantitative distributions
questions.evidence: known_biases gives four entries with controlled bias_type values: selection_bias (recruitment at a limited number of high-volume expert clinics; groups with less trust in medicine or AI, or living further from sites, less likely to be recruited; mitigation of remote collection and recruitment redesign), representation_bias (unequal disease category distribution and skew by disorder, site and demographics; affected_subsets named; mitigation of user-side distribution inspection and further releases), measurement_bias (per-site device and configuration differences, variable headset microphone distance, noise artifacts; affected_subsets named), and annotation_bias (single-clinician diagnosis, EHR- or prescription-derived labels for the psychiatric cohort, inter-site variation in diagnostic practice, temporal drift in criteria). future_use_impacts adds three downstream-risk entries. known_limitations adds six typed limitation entries covering coverage, representativeness, scope, temporal and methodological gaps.
questions.quality_note: Four distinct bias types drawn from a controlled vocabulary, each with a mechanism rather than a label, and two carrying mitigation strategies and affected subsets. That is well past the 3 band. It stops short of 5 on two counts the question names explicitly: no AI Ontology term identifiers are attached to the bias_type values, unlike instances, which does carry B2AI CURIEs, so the taxonomy alignment is by vocabulary rather than by mapping; and the fairness analysis is entirely qualitative, with the skew asserted repeatedly but never quantified by cohort, site or demographic group.

strengths: Ethics and governance documentation is complete across every protection area, with IRB and single-IRB coverage, four-modality consent capture, an explicit withdrawal boundary before and after collection, enumerated removed identifiers, compensation amounts with a per-participant cap, and a Certificate of Confidentiality

Technical provenance is reproducible at parameter level: window, hop, FFT size, mel bin count, sampling rates for articulatory and phoneme features, and a version-pinned generating library (b2aiprep v3.0.0) with linked open-source repositories
Per-variable derivation and measurement_technique give column-granular lineage rather than a single dataset-level provenance statement
Access is fully executable for both tiers, naming the credentialing steps, the signed instruments, the reviewing office with its contact address, the delivery platforms and the absence of fees

The record documents its own uncertainty rather than resolving it silently: source_caveats names three upstream disagreements with the resolution rule applied to each, and purposes[0] carries a nested caveat preserving two conflicting enrollment targets from equal-ranked sources

Negatives are recorded as findings rather than omissions: no cleaning performed, no inter-annotator agreement computable, no impact assessment conducted, no recommended splits, and machine transcriptions explicitly flagged as unaudited
Version history carries a per-release changelog with participant deltas that reconcile arithmetically to the stated total of 833
Four bias types with mechanisms, affected subsets and mitigations, reinforced by six typed known_limitations entries
weaknesses: Only four keywords for a multi-cohort, multi-modality clinical acoustic dataset, naming none of the modalities, disease cohorts, feature families or machine-learning framing that the description covers at length
No demographic distributions anywhere: representation skew is asserted in at least four places but never quantified by cohort, site, sex, race, ethnicity or age band
A blanket statement that no regulatory restrictions apply sits in the same block as a Certificate of Confidentiality, a restricted confidentiality level and credentialed access

All fifteen contributors are typed principal_investigator, including several the record's own notes describe as software, ethics or genomics module leads, and credit_roles is populated on only two entries
No file size or file count metadata: total_size_bytes, total_file_count and file_collections are all unpopulated, so scale can be estimated from record counts but a download cannot be sized
parent_datasets and resources are unused despite a documented five-release lineage and a rich external_resources block, so ancestry is discoverable only through related_datasets
The collection window is a bare twelve-month duration with no anchoring dates, in a record that otherwise carries precise dates for every release
Bias types use a controlled vocabulary but carry no ontology identifiers, unlike instances, which does use B2AI CURIEs
recommendations: Expand keywords to eight or more, drawing terms the description already uses: speech, cough, respiration, voice disorders, neurodegenerative disease, acoustic biomarkers, spectrogram, machine learning, PhysioNet
Add participant counts by disease cohort, by site and by the demographic axes named in subpopulations, so the documented skew becomes measurable rather than asserted
Rewrite the regulatory_restrictions free text to say that no export controls apply, and cross-reference the Certificate of Confidentiality recorded in other_compliance instead of negating it
Reserve principal_investigator for the two co-PIs and express the other thirteen contributions through credit_roles, which the schema already supports and the notes already describe
Populate total_size_bytes and total_file_count, or record file_collections per format so the release can be sized before a download is attempted
Populate parent_datasets with the version predecessors already carried in related_datasets (doi:10.13026/k81f-qr68 for v3.0.0 and doi:10.57764/qb6h-em84 for v1.0)
Anchor collection_timeframes with approximate start and end dates, or state explicitly that the sources give only a duration
Attach AI Ontology identifiers to each known_biases.bias_type, matching the CURIE practice already used in instances.data_topic and data_substrate
Scope is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present to the released feature files, so it no longer contradicts the recorded failure to achieve k-anonymity at k equal to two
